verses: Logon kay hisab ka waqt qareeb aagaya phir bhi woh bey khabri mein mun pheray huye hain
Unn kay pass unn kay rab ki taraf say jo bhi naee naee naseehat aati hai ussay woh khel kood mein hi suntay hain
Unn kay dil bilkul ghafil hain aur unn zalimon ney chupkay chupkay sirgoshiyan kin kay woh tum hi jaisa insan hai, phir kiya wajah hai jo tum aankhon dekhtay jadoo mein aajatay ho
Payghumbar ney kaha mera perwerdigar her uss baat ko jo zamin o aasman mein hai bakhoobi janta hai, woh boht hi sunnay wala aur jannay wala hai

Itna hi nahi balkay)yeh yeh to kehtay hain kay yeh Quran paragandah khuwabon ka majmooa hai balkay)yeh uss ney az khud ussay gharr liya hai balkay)yeh yeh shaeer hai, werna humaray samney yeh koi aisi nishani latay jaisay kay aglay payghumbar bhejay gaye thay
Unn say pehlay jitni bastiyan hum ney ujarin sab eman say khali thin. To kiya abb yeh eman layen gay
Tujh say pehlay jitney payghumbar hum ney bhejay sabhi mard thay jin ki taraf hum wahee utartay thay pus tum ahl kitab say pooch lo agar khud tumhen ilm na ho
Hum ney unn kay aisay jism nahi banaye thay kay woh khana na khayen aur na woh hamesha rehney walay thay
Phir hum ney unn say kiye huye sab waday sachay kiye unhen aur jin jin ko hum ney chaha nijat ata farmaee aur hadd say nikal janey walon ko ghaarat ker diya
Yaqeenan hum ney tumhari janib kitab nazil farmaee hai jiss mein tumharay liye zikar hai, kiya phir bhi tum aqal nahi rakhtay?
Aur boht si bastiyan hum ney tabah ker den jo zalim thin aur unn kay baad hum ney doosri qom ko peda ker diya
Jab unhon ney humaray azab ka ehsas ker liya, to lagay uss say bhagney
Bhaag dor na kero aur jahan tumhen aasoodgi di gaee thi o hain wapis loto aur apney makanaat ki taraf jao takay tum say sawal to ker liya jaye
Kehney lagay haaye humari kharabi! be-shak hum zalim thay
Phir to unn ka yehi qol tha yahan tak kay hum ney unhen jarr say kati hui kheti aur bujhi pari aag (ki tarah) ker diya
Hum ney aasman o zamin aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko kheltay huye nahi banaya
Agar hum yun hi khel tamashay ka iradah kertay to ussay apney pass say hi bana letay, agar hum kerney walay hi hotay
Balkay)yeh hum sach ko jhoot per phenk maartay hain pus sach jhoot ka sir tor deta hai aur woh ussi waqt nabood ho jata hai, tum jo baaten banatay ho woh tumhari liye baees kharabi hain
Aasmano aur zamin mein jo hai ussi Allah ka hai aur jo uss kay pass hain woh uss ki ibadat say na sirkashi kertay hain aur na thaktay hain
Woh din raat tasbeeh biyan kertay hain aur zara si bhi susti nahi kertay
Kiya unn logon ney zamin (ki makhlooqaat mein) say jinhen mabood bana rakha hai woh zindah ker detay hain
Agar aasman o zamin mein siwaye Allah Taalaa kay aur bhi mabood hotay to yeh dono darhum barhum hojatay pus Allah Taalaa arsh ka rab her uss o saff say pak hai jo yeh mushrik biyan kertay hain
Woh apney kaamon kay liye (kissi kay aagay) jawab deh nahi aur sab (uss kay aagay) jawab deh hain

Kiya unn logon ney Allah kay siwa aur mabood bana rakhay hain, unn say keh do lao apni daleel paish kero. Yeh hai meray sath walon ki kitab aur mujh say aglon ki daleel. Baat yeh hai kay unn mein kay aksar log haq ko nahi jantay ussi wajah say mun moray huye hain
Tujh say pehlay bhi jo rasool hum ney bheja uss ki taraf yehi wahee nazil farmaee kay meray siwa koi mabood bar-haq nahi pus tum sab meri hi ibadat kero
(mushrik log) kehtay hain kay rehman aulad wala hai (ghalat hai) uss ki zaat pak hai, balkay)yeh woh sab uss kay ba-izzat banday hain
Kissi baat mein Allah per paish dasti nahi kertay balkay)yeh uss kay farman per band hain
Woh unn kay aagay peechay tamam umoor say waqif hai woh kissi ki bhi sifarish nahi kertay ba-juz unn kay jin say Allah khush ho woh to khud haibat elahi say larzan o tarsan hain
Unn mein say agar koi bhi keh dey kay Allah kay siwa mein laeeq ibadat hun to hum ussay dozakh ki saza den hum zalimon ko ussi tarah saza detay hain
Kiya kafir logon ney yeh nahi dekha kay aasman o zamin bahum milay julay thay phir hum ney unhen juda kiya aur her zindah cheez ko hum ney pani say peda kiya, kiya yeh log phir bhi eman nahi latay
Aur hum ney zamin mein pahar bana diye takay woh makhlooq ko hila na sakay, aur hum ney uss mein kushadah raahen bana den takay woh raasta hasil keren
Aasman ko mehfooz chat bhi hum ney hi banaya hai. Lekin log uss ki qudrat kay namoono per dehan nahi dhartay
O hi Allah hai jiss ney raat aur din aur sooraj aur chand ko peda kiya hai. Unn mein say her aik apney apney madaar mein tertay phirtay hain
Aap say pehlay kissi insan ko bhi hum ney hameshgi nahi di, kiya agar aap marr to woh hamesha kay liye reh jayen gay
Her jaan daar maut ka maza chakhney wala hai. Hum ba-tareeq imtehan tum mein say her aik ko buraee bhalaee mein mubtila kertay hain aur tum sab humari hi taraf lotaye jao gay

Yeh munkireen tujhay jab bhi dekhtay hain to tumhara mazaq hi uratay hain kay kiya yehi woh hai jo tumharay maboodon ka zikar buraee say kerta hai, aur woh khud hi rehman ki yaad kay bilkul hi munkir hain
Insan jald baaz makhlooq hai. Mein tumhen apni nishaniyan abhi abhi dikhaoon ga tum mujh say jald baazi na kero
Kehtay hain kay agar sachay ho to bata do kay yeh wada kab hai
Kaash! yeh kafir jantay kay uss waqt na to yeh kafir aag ko apney chehron say hata saken gay aur na apni peethon say aur na unn ki madad ki jaye gi
(haan haan!) waday ki ghari unn kay pass achanak aajaye gi aur unhen hakka bakka ker dey gi, phir na to yeh log ussay taal saken gay aur na zara si bhi mohlat diye jayen gay
Aur tujh say pehlay rasoolon kay sath bhi hansi mazaq kiya gaya pus hansi kerney walon ko hi uss cheez ney gher liya jiss ki woh hansi uratay thay
Unn say poochiye kay rehman say, din aur raat tumhari hifazat kaun ker sakta hai? Baat yeh hai kay yeh log apney rab kay zikar say phiray huye hain
Kiya humaray siwa unn kay aur mabood hain jo unhen musibaton say bacha len. Koi bhi khud apni madad ki taqat nahi rakhta aur na koi humari taraf say rafaqat diya jata hai

Balkay)yeh hum ney unhen aur unn kay baap dadon ko zindagi kay saman diye yahan tak kay unn ki muddat umar guzar gaee. Kiya woh nahi dekhtay kay hum zamin ko uss kay kinaron say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain, abb kiya o hi ghalib hain?
Keh dijiye! mein to tumhen Allah ki wahee kay zariye aagah ker raha hun magar behray log baat nahi suntay jabkay unhen aagah kiya jaye
Agar unhen teray rab kay kissi azab ka jhonka bhi lag jaye to pukar uthen kay haaye humari bad-bakhti! yaqeenan hum gunehgar thay

Qayamat kay din hum darmiyan mein laa rakhen gay theek theek tolney wali tarazoo ko. Phir kissi per kuch bhi zulm na kiya jaye ga. Aur agar aik raaee kay daney kay barabar bhi amal hoga hum ussay laa hazir keren gay, aur hum kafi hain hisab kerney walay
Yeh bilkul sach hai kay hum ney Musa o Haroon ko faislay kerney wali noorani aur perhezgaron kay liye waaz o naseehat wali kitab ata farmaee
Woh log jo apney rab say bann dekhay khof khatay hain aur qayamat (kay tasawwur) say kaanptay rehtay hain
Aur yeh naseehat o barkat wala Quran bhi hum hi ney nazil farmaya hai kiya phir bhi tum uss kay munkir ho
Yaqeenan hum ney uss say pehlay Ibrahim ko uss ki samajh bojh bakhshi thi aur hum uss kay ehwaal say bakhoobi waqif thay
Jabkay uss ney apney baap say aur apni qom say kaha kay yeh moortiyan jin kay tum mujawar banay bethay ho kiya hain?
Sab ney jawab diya kay hum ney apney baap dada ko unhi ki ibadat kertay huye paya
Aap ney farmaya! phir to tum aur tumharay baap dada sabhi yaqeenan khulli gumrahi mein mubtila rahey
Kehney lagay kiya aap humaray pass sach much haq laye hain ya yun hi mazaq ker rahey hain
Aap ney farmaya nahi dar-haqeeqat tum sab ka perwerdigar to woh hai jo aasmano aur zamin ka malik hai jiss ney unhen peda kiya hai, mein to ussi baat ka gawah aur qaeel hun
Aur Allah ki qasam! mein tumharay unn maboodon kay sath jab tum alehda peeth pher ker chal do gay aik chaal chalon ga
Pus uss ney unn sab kay tukray tukray ker diye haan sirf baray butt ko chor diya yeh bhi uss liye kay woh sab uss ki taraf hi loten
Kehney lagay kay humaray khudaon kay sath yeh kiss ney kiya? Aisa shakhs to yaqeenan zalimon mein say hai
Bolay hum ney aik no-jawan ko unn ka tazkarah kertay huye suna tha jissay Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) kaha jata hai
Sab ney kaha acha ussay majmay mein logon ki nigahon kay samney lao takay sab dekhen
Kehney lagay! aey Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) kiya tu ney hi humaray khudaon kay sath yeh harkat ki hai
Aap ney jawab diya balkay)yeh uss kaam ko unn kay baray ney kiya hai tum apney khudaon say hi pooch lo agar yeh boltay chaltay hun
Pus yeh log apney dilon mein qaeel hogaye aur kehney lagay waqaee zalim to tum hi ho
Phir apney saron kay bal ondhay hogaye (aur kehney lagay kay) yeh to tujhay bhi maloom hai kay yeh bolney chaalney walay nahi
Allah kay khalil ney ussi waqt farmaya afsos! kiya tum Allah kay alawa unn ki ibadat kertay ho jo na tumhen kuch bhi nafa phoncha saken na nuksan
Tuff hai tum per aur unn per jin ki tum Allah kay siwa ibadat kertay ho. Kiya tumhen itni si aqal bhi nahi?
Kehney lagay kay ussay jila do aur apney khudaon ki madad kero agar tumhen kuch kerna hi hai
Hum ney farma diya aey aag! to thandi parr jaa aur Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) kay liye salamti (aur aaram ki cheez) bann jaa
Go unhon ney Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ka bura chaha, lekin hum ney unhen nakaam bana diya
Aur hum Ibrahim aur Loot ko bacha ker uss zamin ki taraf ley chalay jiss mein hum ney tamam jahaan walon kay liye barkat rakhi thi
Aur hum ney ussay Ishaq ata farmaya Yaqoob uss per mazeed. Aur her ko hum ney saleh banaya

Aur hum ney unhen paishwa bana diya kay humaray hukum say logon ki rehbari keren aur hum ney unn ki taraf nek kaamon kay kerney aur namazon kay qaeem rakhney aur zakat denay ki wahee (talqeen) ki, aur woh sab kay sab humaray ibadat guzaar banday thay
Hum ney Loot (alaihi as-salam) ko bhi hukum aur ilm diya aur ussay ussi basti say nijat di jahan kay log ganday kaamon mein mubtila thay. Aur thay bhi bad-tareen gunehgar
Aur hum ney Loot (alaihi as-salam) ko apni rehmat mein dakhil ker liya bey shak woh neko kaar logon mein say tha
Nooh kay uss waqt ko yaad kijiye jabkay uss ney uss say pehlay dua ki hum ney uss ki dua qabool farmaee aur ussay aur uss kay ghar walon ko baray karb say nijat di
Aur jo log humari aayaton ko jhutla rahey thay unn kay muqablay mein hum ney uss ki madad ki, yaqeenan woh buray log thay pus hum unn sab ko dobo diya

Aur Dawood aur Sulaiman (alaihima as-salam) ko yaad kijiye jabkay woh khet kay moamla mein faisla ker rahey thay kay kuch logon ki bakriyan raat ko uss mein char chug gaee thin, aur unn kay faislay mein hum mojood thay

Hum ney uss ka sahih faisla Sulaiman ko samjha diya. Haan her aik ko hum ney hukum o ilm dey rakha tha aur Dawood kay tabey hum ney pahar ker diye thay jo tasbeeh kertay thay aur parind bhi. Hum kerney walay hi thay
Aur hum ney ussay tumharay liye libas bananey ki karigari sikhaee takay laraee kay zarar say tumhara bachao ho. Kiya tum shukar guzaar bano gay?

Hum ney tund o tez hua ko Sulaiman (alaihi as-salam) kay tabey ker diya jo uss kay farman kay mutabiq uss zamin ki taraf chalti thi jahan hum ney barkat dey rakhi thi, aur hum her cheez say ba-khabar aur dana hain
Ussi tarah say boht say shayateen bhi hum ney uss kay tabey kiye thay jo uss kay farman say ghotay lagatay thay aur uss kay siwa bhi boht say kaam kertay thay, unn kay nigehbaan hum hi thay
Ayyub (alaihi as-salam) ki uss halat ko yaad kero jabkay uss ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara kay mujhay yeh beemari lag gaee hai aur to reham kerney walon say ziyadah reham kerney wala hai

To hum ney uss ki sunn li aur jo dukh unhen tha ussay door ker diya aur uss ko ahl o ayaal ata farmaye balkay)yeh unn kay sath wesay hi aur apni khaas meharbani say takay sachay bandon kay liye sabab naseehat ho
Aur Ismail aur Idrees aur Zul-Kifl, (alaihim as-salam) yeh sab sabir log thay
Hum ney unhen apni rehmat mein dakhil ker liya. Yeh sab log nek thay

Machli walay (hazrat Yunus alaihi as-salam) ko yaad kero! jabkay woh ghussa say chal diya aur khayal kiya kay hum ussay na pakar saken gay. Bil-aakhir woh andheron kay andar say pukar utha kay elahi teray siwa koi mabood nahi to pak hai, be-shak mein zalimon mein ho gaya
To hum ney uss ki pukar sunn li aur ussay ghum say nijat dey di aur hum eman walon ko ussi tarah bacha liya kertay hain
Aur Zakariya (alaihi as-salam) ko yaad kero jab uss ney apney rab say dua ki kay aey meray perwerdigar! mujhay tanha na chor, to sab say behtar waris hai

Hum ney uss ki dua ko qabool farma ker ussay yahya (alaihi as-salam) ata farmaya aur unn ki biwi ko unn kay liye durust ker diya. Yeh buzurg log nek kaamon ki taraf jaldi kertay thay aur humen lalach tama aur darr khof say pukartay thay. Aur humaray samney aajzi kerney walay thay
Aur woh pak daman bibi bibi jiss ney apni asmat ki hifazat ki hum ney uss kay andar rooh say phoonk di aur khud unhen aur unn kay larkay ko tamam jahaan kay liye nishani bana diya
Yeh tumhari ummat hai jo haqeeqat mein aik hi ummat hai, aur mein tum sab ka perwerdigar hun pus tum meri hi ibadat kero
Magar logon aapas mein apney deen mein firqay bandiyan ker len, sab kay sab humari hi taraf lotney walay hain
Phir jo bhi nek amal keray aur woh momin (bhi) ho to uss ki koshish ki bey qadri nahi ki jaye gi. Hum to uss kay likhney walay hain
Aur jiss basti ko hum ney halak ker diya uss per lazim hai kay o haan kay log palat ker nahi aayen gay
Yahan tak kay yajooj aur majooj khol diye jayen gay aur woh her bulandi say dortay huye aayen gay
Aur sacha wada qareeb lagay ga uss waqt kafiron ki nigahen phati ki phati reh jayen gi, kay haaye afsos! hum uss haal say ghafil thay balkay)yeh fi fil-waqey hum qusoor waar thay
Tum aur Allah kay siwa jin jin ki tum ibadat kertay ho, sab dozakh ka endhan bano gay, tum sab dozakh mein janey walay ho
Agar yeh (sachay) mabood hotay to jahannum mein dakhil na hotay, aur sab kay sab ussi mein hamesha rehney walay hain
Woh o haan chala rahey hun gay aur o haan kuch bhi na sunn saken gay
Albatta bey shak jin kay liye humari taraf say neki pehlay hi thehar chuki hai. Woh sab jahannum say door hi rakhay jayen gay
Woh to dozakh ki aahat tak na sunen gay aur apni mann bhati cheezon mein hamesha rehney walay hun gay
Woh bari ghabrahat (bhi) unhen ghumgeen na ker sakay gi aur farishtay unhen hathon hath len gay, kay yehi tumhara woh din hai jiss ka tum wada diye jatay rahey

Jiss din hum aasman ko yun lapet len gay jaisay toomaar mein oraaq lapet diye jatay hain, jaisay kay hum ney awwal dafa pedaeesh ki thi ussi tarah doobara keren gay. Yeh humaray zimmay wada hai aur hum ussay zaroor ker kay (hi) rahen gay
Hum Zaboor mein pind o naseehat kay baad yeh likh chukay hain kay zamin kay waris meray nek banday (hi) hun gay
Ibadat guzaar bandon kay liye to uss mein aik bara paygham hai
Aur hum ney aap ko tamam jahaan walon kay liye rehmat bana ker hi bheja hai
Keh dijiye! meray pass to pus wahee ki jati hai kay tum sab ka mabood aik hi hai, to kiya tum bhi uss ki farmanbardari kerney walay ho?
Phir agar yeh mun mor len to keh dijiye kay mein ney tumhen yaksan tor per khabardaar ker diya hai. Mujhay ilm nahi kay jiss ka wada tum say kiya jaa raha hai woh qareeb hai ya door
Albatta Allah Taalaa to khulli aur zahir baat ko bhi janta hai aur jo tum chupatay ho ussay bhi janta hai
Mujhay uss ka bhi ilm nahi, mumkin hai yeh tumhari aazmaeesh ho aur aik muqarrara waqt tak ka faeedah (phonchana) hai
Khud nabi ney kaha aey rab! insaf kay sath faisla farma aur humara rab bara meharban hai jiss say madad talab ki jati hai unn baaton per jo tum biyan kertay ho
